content: Now this is a bit of a weird one. the Spear made out of Air Elemetal was intended to be thrown at high speeds, but it's just too heavy to throw
It's only when you used it as a regular spear that you discovered where it truly shines, there are 2 modes to this spear.
Running while charging the Spear causes you to speed up, as if the spear is carving a path for you to run through. Aerodynamics and all that.
While standing still, you can charge the spear to create a small vortex that draws in enemies and launches them when you release.
